segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-on
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the network sign-on and countdown; Case Blackwell opens the broadcast noting sub goal scheduling uncertainty.

segments.title: News Desk: DeepSeek, Heathcliff, and Market Reaction
segments.notes: Case and Munch banter about Heathcliff's girlfriends before discussing Chinese AI DeepSeek triggering a U.S. tech stock sell-off; Case prompts DeepSeek to write a Heathcliff parody song about Jeff Ripple.

segments.title: How To with Jeb: Bodybuilding Poses, Girlfriend Advice, and the I Love You Test
segments.notes: Jeb and his board-trapped father watch instructional videos on bodybuilding posing, relationship advice from 'Dear Cyber Sue,' and Evan Michaels' 'I Love You Test'; Jeb attempts the test on Kendall, resulting in a $700 payout.

segments.title: News Desk: Trump Cabinet Confirmations
segments.notes: Case and security guard Craig discuss confirmations of Pete Hegseth (Defense), Marco Rubio, John Ratcliffe (CIA), and Kristi Noem (Homeland Security), with commentary on Hegseth's oath ceremony.

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Viewer Video Submissions
segments.notes: Case and Craig rate viewer-submitted videos including a roach torture clip, cosplay, a gender reveal, a yogurt jar opening, a cringe influencer, and a Canadian drinking bit; zero scores dominate.

segments.title: Chet Guy the Science Eyes: Future Dick Science
segments.notes: Chet and ChetAI interrupt the broadcast to analyze a Unilad article claiming average penis size has grown 25% since 1992 and may reach 8.5 inches, with speculation on built-in contraception and vaginal changes; ChetAI glitches during math.

segments.title: Hype Train: New Theme Debut
segments.notes: Hype Train appears with a new theme based on Quad City DJs' 'Come On Ride the Train,' briefly interacts with the DJs before the segment ends abruptly.

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Trent at the Movies (Trailer Reviews)
segments.notes: Case and Trip Bradstein (as 'Trent') watch trailers for Bubble Ghost (Game Boy), Modern Vampires (1998), an FX alien series, a PSVR2 horror game 'The Obsessive Shadow,' and a Jack Black mid-2000s project.

segments.title: Trip on the Street: Park Opinions and Content Brainstorm
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein collects opinions from park denizens including a Pepsi-deprived Costco shopper, Mountain Mark (moon man battle), the Canadian Tickler, a JD Vance impersonator demanding 'wiener' restored to 'dong,' a corporate undermining advisor, a Hamtaro fan, and HR impostor Brock Stickman/Jack Jackoff; Kendall joins for content strategy brainstorming.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: Executive Producer. Delivered the station sign-on and countdown, managed broadcast flow, and refused to block strangers from the satellite room.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Lead Anchor. Anchored the News desk, hosted Amongst the Web and Chet segments, debuted Hype Train's new theme, and discussed Disney pass renewal with Kendall.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: Debate Analyst. Sparred with Case on the News desk over Heathcliff lore and DeepSeek market impact.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: How To Host. Hosted the instructional segment from his workshop with his deceased father trapped in a wooden board.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: Co-host (Spirit in Wood). Bickered with Jeb from inside a wooden board, claimed Tinder presence, and referenced replacing his wife's first husband at Chuck E. Cheese.

characters.name: Kendall
characters.notes: In-Studio Contributor. Endured Jeb's 'I Love You Test' confession for $700, then joined Trip's park segment to brainstorm content ideas including 'cupcake for confessions.'

characters.name: Rick (Craig)
characters.role: Security Guard / Amongst the Web Co-host
characters.notes: Security Guard / Amongst the Web Co-host. Co-hosted Amongst the Web video ratings while claiming to be Ben Affleck's former security.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: Chief Science Correspondent. Commandeered the broadcast for a penis growth study analysis, deploying ChetAI for math and future-vision glitches.

characters.name: ChetAI
characters.notes: Neural Co-host. Attempted to calculate 25% of 4.8 inches, glitched into a future vision, and offered 'elephant' as a possible answer.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: Musical Interruption. Debuted a new Quad City DJs-based theme music and briefly interacted with the DJs before being cut off.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: Field Correspondent. Hosted Trip on the Street from park bushes, collecting opinions from eccentric park denizens and brainstorming with Kendall.

lore_notes.fact: Case's sub goal streaming schedule remains uncertain, possibly Tuesday or weekend.
Kendall's 'Filipino son' puppet is in a pirate phase and says 'Oi.'
Jeb's Dad claims he replaced his wife's first husband at Chuck E. Cheese while the husband was very sick.
Jeb paid Kendall $700 after attempting the 'I Love You Test' on her during the How To segment.
ChetAI glitched into a future vision while calculating 25% of 4.8, offering answers '1.2' or 'elephant.'
Hype Train adopted a new theme based on Quad City DJs' 'Come On Ride the Train.'
Case and Kendall re-purchased Disneyland annual passes and are planning a Disney World trip with Genie+.
Case experienced leg pain on the Tron coaster at Shanghai Disney due to tight seating.
Brock Stickman claims to be HR at Kendall's company; Jack Jackoff revealed as stacked towels in a hoodie impersonating him.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with Pepito's sign-on and a News desk deep-dive into DeepSeek's market disruption and Heathcliff's romantic history. The broadcast cycled through a Jeb-led instructional segment culminating in a $700 'I Love You Test' payout, a cabinet confirmation recap, a brutal Amongst the Web viewer video block, a Chet Guy the Science Eyes investigation into alleged penis size inflation, a Hype Train theme overhaul, a movie trailer review block, and an extended Trip on the Street featuring park denizens and a Kendall content strategy session.
